title: Dramatic Trio Highlights — Kurozane, Mateus & Nikola
translationStatus: All 80 English lines are verbatim canonical Campaign script (including all 30 remaining Shogun Kurozane lines before Dawn at the Observatory). Japanese lines are character-register draft translations awaiting native review.

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Crisp, amused challenge from the shadows; enjoys catching strangers mid-lockpick.
lines.en: That permit bears a lawful Takamine seal. Explain why an authorized carrier is opening a court lock incorrectly.
lines.ja: その通行証には正規の高峰印がある。なぜ認可された飛脚が、公儀の錠前を誤った手順で開けているのか説明してもらおう。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Dry, self-satisfied wit; effortlessly breezy.
lines.en: I landed where the guard stopped being attached to it.
lines.ja: 番兵がその鍵を手放した場所に着地したまでだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Light, wry aside; mildly proud of his restraint.
lines.en: Sleeping with a headache and fewer professional options.
lines.ja: 頭痛と、少しばかり減った職の選択肢を抱えて眠っているよ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Suddenly cool and assessing; hunter's discipline beneath the banter.
lines.en: I was not offering reassurance. I was measuring whether you would shout before thinking.
lines.ja: 安心させたつもりはない。考える前に叫ぶ人間かどうか測っていただけだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Gravity drops in cleanly; names the burned archive without theatrics.
lines.en: Because a black-alloy bell crossed an ocean after burning an archive that should have remained beyond its reach.
lines.ja: 黒合金の鐘が、本来なら手の届くはずのない書庫を焼き払ったあと、海を越えてここへ運ばれたからだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Wry, guarded; quiet irony.
lines.en: Names are expensive in buildings that stamp blank confessions.
lines.ja: 白紙の自白書に印を押す建物の中では、名前は高くつくものだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Grand self-introduction with a slight stiff flourish in formal speech.
lines.en: Count Nikola Dražanić of Branik. In your language, I seek the evil bell beneath this honorable prison.
lines.ja: ブラニク伯ニコラ・ドラジャニッチ。お前たちの言葉で言うなら、この立派な牢の下にある邪悪な鐘を探している。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Proud, slightly defensive grandeur, smoothing over his claim.
lines.en: A frontier does not wait for a distant clerk to ratify the man defending it. Dražanić will suffice here.
lines.ja: 辺境は、それを守る男の称号を遠い書記が認めるまで待ってはくれん。ここではドラジャニッチで十分だ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Crisp, appreciative amusement.
lines.en: Temporarily is an excellent length for trust.
lines.ja: 一時的とは、信頼にちょうどいい長さだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Measured closing deal; blade lowered, focus sharp.
lines.en: Show me the fracture, and we will learn whether three separate hunts have found the same stair.
lines.ja: 破断面を見せてみろ。三つの別々の追跡が、同じ階段に辿り着いたのか確かめよう。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Spent, quiet after the Blood Ward breaks; neither pleading nor boasting.
lines.en: The ward is finished. I have neither breath nor argument enough to rebuild it.
lines.ja: 結界は終わりだ。組み直す息も、言い訳も、私にはもう残っていない。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Sharp prosecution; drops the charm completely.
lines.en: You had argument enough to order guards against prisoners and call it necessity before the whole chamber heard us.
lines.ja: 部屋じゅうに聞こえる前で、囚人たちに番兵を差し向け、それを必要と呼ぶだけの理屈はあったはずだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Plain, unflinching confession; every clause weighed like testimony.
lines.en: I ordered the witnesses contained. I intended to take the Dražanić heir alive. I intended to burn these records.
lines.ja: 私は証人の封じ込めを命じた。ドラジャニッチの後継を生け捕りにするつもりだった。この記録を焼き払うつもりだった。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Bitter scholarly self-audit; refuses to flatter his own rite.
lines.en: A threat designed to look like sacrifice. It harmed me visibly so others would mistake spectacle for reluctance.
lines.ja: 犠牲に見えるよう仕立てた脅しだ。目に見える傷を己に負わせ、見世物をためらいと取り違えさせるためのな。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Bone-dry, merciless clarity.
lines.en: The pain was real. The moral use I made of it was false.
lines.ja: 痛みは本物だった。それに与えた道義の使い道が偽りだったのだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Cold recognition; quiet intensity as the stitch reveals the quarry.
lines.en: That cipher belonged to my teacher. You are the quarry named in the last letter he sent west.
lines.ja: その暗号は我が師のものだ。貴様が、師が西へ送った最後の手紙に記した獲物だな。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Weary admission; does not dodge the charge.
lines.en: I adapted his method after his death. Your hunt found the correct thief.
lines.ja: 師の死後、私がその手法を転用した。お前の追跡は、正しい盗人を見つけたのだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Measured, somber; names the dead plainly.
lines.en: Miklos Dražanić's, outside Branik. I was told no student survived the archive fire.
lines.ja: ブラニク郊外のミクロシュ・ドラジャニッチだ。書庫の火事で生き残った弟子はいないと聞かされていた。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Cutting, quiet contempt.
lines.en: You were told what made your theft feel ownerless.
lines.ja: 盗んだものに持ち主がいないと思える話だけを聞かされたのだろう。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Flat, honest, zero defense.
lines.en: I accepted what made it useful.
lines.ja: 役に立つ話だけを、私が受け入れたのだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Short, disgusted realization.
lines.en: You made accusation portable.
lines.ja: 告発を運べる形に変えたのか。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Grave, exact indictment of his own craft.
lines.en: And made distance resemble verification. A copied mark could condemn someone no listener had ever met.
lines.ja: そして距離を裏付けに見せかけた。写し取った印一つで、誰も会ったことのない人間を有罪にできたのだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Scholarly precision naming the Severed Dragon precedent.
lines.en: I translated its legal check: witnesses severed an immortal ruler from office and army.
lines.ja: 私はその法的な歯止めを訳した。証人たちが、不死の統治者を役職と軍から切り離す定めをな。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Rare, stark honesty about his own house's corruption.
lines.en: My house corrupted that check into hereditary purge authority.
lines.ja: 我が一門はその歯止めを、世襲の粛清権へと歪めた。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Quietly damning self-testimony.
lines.en: Kurozane rewarded my willing translation because it made permanent rule appear lawful.
lines.ja: 黒実が私の進んで行った翻訳に報いたのは、それが永続する支配を合法に見せたからだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Unsentimental pragmatism; expects no grace.
lines.en: No. I expect you to use what I know before he makes it useless.
lines.ja: いいえ。奴が使い物にならなくする前に、私の知ることを利用せよと言っている。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Steel-cold boundary; hunter's promise still active.
lines.en: You remain my quarry, Avelar. Opening these cells changes how I take you, not whether I do.
lines.ja: 貴様は依然として俺の獲物だ、アヴェラール。この牢を開けたところで、討つか否かは変わらん。討ち方が変わるだけだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.section: Act II — A Name from Europe
lines.direction: Composed, weary acceptance of the terms.
lines.en: I am not asking for forgiveness. I am naming one action available before my superiors revoke it.
lines.ja: 許しを請うているのではない。上役が取り消す前に取れる、たった一つの行動を示しているだけだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Unusually quiet, holding the old page by lantern light.
lines.en: My grandmother copied this seal from an old book without witnesses.
lines.ja: 祖母は証人も置かずに、古い書物からこの印を書き写した。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Low, level; states the blood debt without raising his voice.
lines.en: And the sentence beneath it gave your family permission to hunt mine.
lines.ja: そしてその下に記された一文が、お前の家に私の一族を狩る許しを与えた。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Quiet, unflinching self-correction.
lines.en: It gave us permission to call hunting protection.
lines.ja: 狩りを「護り」と呼ぶ許しを与えたのだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Plain, direct, stripped of bravado.
lines.en: No. I asked you here because the new words may affect where you stand in battle.
lines.ja: いや。新しい言葉が、戦場でお前の立つ場所に関わるかもしれんから呼んだのだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Measured caution; refuses easy warmth.
lines.en: That is a reason. It is not yet a promise I trust.
lines.ja: それは理由にはなる。だが、私が信じられる約束にはまだなっていない。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Sharp clerical warning against cheap solidarity.
lines.en: Do not build fellowship from recognizing the shape of each other's excuses.
lines.ja: 互いの言い訳の形を見抜いたからといって、そこに仲間意識を築くな。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Quiet test; pushes the question straight onto himself.
lines.en: And when the danger has my blood?
lines.ja: では、その危険が私の血を引いていたらどうする。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Clean, absolute, zero flourish.
lines.en: Blood will not be the charge. What you do will be.
lines.ja: 血を罪状にはしない。何をしたかを問う。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Firm, sober conviction.
lines.en: It must be. An oath that only judges strangers is a badge, not restraint.
lines.ja: そうでなければならん。他人だけを裁く誓いは記章であって、歯止めではない。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Solemn spoken vow, deliberate cadence, no pomp.
lines.en: I inherit no such right. I will sever blood from command, protect named people, and leave judgment outside my house.
lines.ja: 俺はそのような権利を継がない。血を命令から切り離し、名のある人々を護り、裁きは我が家の外へ置く。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Quiet honesty; refuses false closure.
lines.en: Whatever you write will not settle what stands between our families or between us.
lines.ja: お前が何を書こうと、二つの家と俺たちのあいだにあるものは精算されない。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Quiet, grounded close; genuinely humbled.
lines.en: It is not a settlement. It is a limit I am choosing to place on myself.
lines.ja: 精算ではない。俺が自らに課すと選んだ歯止めだ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Courtly host welcoming intruders into his glass hall; enjoys the cadence.
lines.en: Enter, seven dissenting notes. Six chambers are tuned. The seventh may tell me which old name unlocks hers.
lines.ja: 入れ、七つの不協和音よ。六つの間はすでに調律を終えた。七つ目の名は、どの古い呼び名が彼女を開くのか余に教えてくれよう。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Silky, mildly amused at Miyo's defiance.
lines.en: Then stand unclassified, Senda, and watch whether your companions are as difficult to catalogue.
lines.ja: ならば未分類のまま立っているがいい、センダ。仲間たちが同じほど目録に収め難いか、見届けることだ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Persuasive aphorism; almost gentle.
lines.en: Understanding is merely surveillance that survives long enough to become tender.
lines.ja: 理解とは、優しさを帯びるまで長く続いた監視にすぎぬ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Affable collector offering Aya her private paradise.
lines.en: Archivist, even now you mark an exit before admiring the collection. Let me cure you of unfinished shelves.
lines.ja: 書庫守よ、収蔵を愛でる前にまず出口を確かめるか。未完の棚という病を、余が癒やしてやろう。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Seductive rhythm, listing symmetry as comfort.
lines.en: No gaps. No disputed hand. No witness arriving years late to disorder your beautiful conclusion.
lines.ja: 欠落もなく、疑わしい筆致もない。何年も遅れて現れた証人が、お前の美しい結論を乱すこともない。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Cool, clipped finality.
lines.en: A door is where error enters.
lines.ja: 扉とは、誤りが入り込む場所だ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Warm, almost paternal temptation addressed to Ren.
lines.en: Courier, you could sleep without guessing which road becomes a grave. Obey one enduring will, and uncertainty dies first.
lines.ja: 飛脚よ、どの道が墓場になるか怯えずに眠れるのだぞ。変わらぬ一つの意志に従えば、まず不確かさが死ぬ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Chillingly calm imperial philosophy.
lines.en: People are always outside something. Government is the art of making the outside inaudible.
lines.ja: 人は常に何かの外側にいるものだ。政とは、その外側の声を聞こえなくする技である。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Silky provocation aimed at Nikola's ancestral pride.
lines.en: Dražanić, I offer the clean ending your ancestors lacked courage to complete. No monster survives to test your revised tenderness.
lines.ja: ドラジャニッチよ、お前の先祖がやり遂げる勇気を欠いた清らかな結末を授けよう。お前の書き換えた優しさを試す怪物など、一匹も残らぬ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Quiet, dangerous focus; refuses the silver horizon immediately.
lines.en: You have placed Mateus's face among the dead before I have named an act or heard a witness.
lines.ja: 俺が罪行を一つも挙げず、証人も聴かぬうちから、貴様はマテウスの顔を死者の中に並べたな。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Dry, aristocratic sneer.
lines.en: The species is the testimony. Your blood once understood efficiency.
lines.ja: 種族そのものが証言だ。お前の血はかつて、効率というものを理解していた。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Intimate, soft cruelty offering oblivion to Mateus.
lines.en: My faithless interpreter, I can remove the night patrols, the translated orders, the mouths you trained yourself not to see.
lines.ja: 不実な通訳よ。夜回りも、訳した命令も、見ぬよう自らを鍛えたあの口々も、余がすべて取り除いてやれる。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Soft, poisoned consolation.
lines.en: From you. The dead have never complained of your remembering.
lines.ja: お前からだ。死者が、お前の記憶に文句を言ったことなど一度もあるまい。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Steady, quiet refusal; guilt carried as duty to the living.
lines.en: The living have. They require my memory to answer questions I would rather escape.
lines.ja: 生きている者が求めている。私が逃げたい問いに答えるため、私の記憶を必要としているのだ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Resonant courtly promise addressed to Genta.
lines.en: Captain, rank without compromise. Every gate opens because your order and the good of the road are finally identical.
lines.ja: 隊長よ、妥協なき階級だ。お前の命令と街道の安寧がついに一致したがゆえに、すべての門が開かれる。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Knowing, quietly barbed observation.
lines.en: Yet your shoulders remember how beautifully the armor distributed blame.
lines.ja: それでもお前の肩は覚えているはずだ。あの鎧がいかに美しく責任を分け与えてくれたかを。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Gentle, terrible bargain offered to Kiku.
lines.en: Healer, no fever, no storm, no child asking why your hands were not enough. Only say that distant suffering weighs less.
lines.ja: 医者よ、熱病も嵐もなく、なぜお前の手では足りなかったのかと問う子もいない。ただ、遠い苦しみは軽いと一言言えばよい。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Light, condescending aesthetic objection.
lines.en: Why bruise perfection with its underside?
lines.ja: なぜ裏側などで完璧を傷つける必要がある。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Measured ledger recitation; crisp naming of each temptation.
lines.en: Ren: safety through obedience. Aya: a perfect archive. Nikola: the war that makes your covenant necessary again.
lines.ja: レンには服従による安寧。アヤには完璧な書庫。ニコラには、お前の盟約を再び必要とさせる戦。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Completes the ledger with smooth sovereign poise.
lines.en: Mateus: no guilt. Genta: restored rank. Kiku: a village untouched by pain.
lines.ja: マテウスには罪なき忘却。ゲンタには復された階級。キクには痛みの触れぬ村だ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Dry, amused scorn as they dissect the glass petals.
lines.en: How solemnly you inspect gifts. Desire does not become pure because you inventory its victims before accepting.
lines.ja: なんと厳粛に贈り物を検分することか。受け取る前に犠牲者の目録を作ったところで、欲望が清らかになるわけではあるまい。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Clear, public refusal; anchored by his revised oath.
lines.en: The empty horizon asks me to inherit a purge claim I have already placed under public correction.
lines.ja: 空っぽの地平線は、すでに公の訂正に付した粛清の権利を継げと俺に求めている。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Grave verdict; every syllable steady.
lines.en: The blank wall offers relief by destroying testimony. That is not freedom from guilt; it is another crime against memory.
lines.ja: 白紙の壁は、証言を滅ぼすことで安らぎを差し出す。それは罪からの解放ではない。記憶に対する新たな罪だ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Rising sovereign command; turns their refusals into armor.
lines.en: Then speak your refusals one by one. Each will tune my armor to the shape of your certainty.
lines.ja: ならば一人ずつ拒絶を述べよ。その一つひとつが、お前たちの確信の形に合わせて余の鎧を調律する。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Grand exit summons; echoing across the Conservatory.
lines.en: Choose your six little boundaries. I shall meet you at the Bell with all the centuries you left outside them.
lines.ja: 六つの小さな境界を選ぶがいい。その外に置き去りにしたすべての世紀を携え、余は鐘のもとで待っている。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Lofty contempt from the Bell spine; surveying the party below.
lines.en: You refused six mercies and brought your contradictions here as if plurality were armor.
lines.ja: 六つの慈悲を拒み、まるで多さそのものが鎧になるかのように矛盾を抱えてここへ来たか。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Clear tactical readout under the Bell's resonance.
lines.en: The Bell will expose them in sequence, but Kurozane can change the sequence with a court command.
lines.ja: 鐘は順に節を晒すが、黒実は公儀の命令でその順序を書き換えられる。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Grand, dark poetry; enjoys claiming history itself.
lines.en: Read me, captain. I am the annotation your country has written in blood and pretended was weather.
lines.ja: 余を読んでみろ、隊長よ。余は、この国が血で記しながら天候のせいにしてきた注釈そのものだ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Quiet, cutting dismissal.
lines.en: How small rebellion sounds when made practical.
lines.ja: 実務に落とし込まれた反逆とは、かくも小さく響くものか。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Brisk battlefield warning.
lines.en: Then it is a command echo. Strike it and the real ward gains what you spend.
lines.ja: ならばそれは命令の残響だ。斬りつければ、本物の結界がお前たちの費やした力を吸い上げる。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Intimate mockery aimed directly at Mateus.
lines.en: Still translating me, Mateus? You always served best when pretending language was neutral.
lines.ja: まだ余を翻訳しているのか、マテウス。言葉は中立だと装うときほど、お前はよく仕えたものだ。

lines.speaker: mateus
lines.direction: Plain, public confession spoken across the battle floor.
lines.en: I translated the Severed Dragon check for Kurozane, turning limited immortal command into permanent rule.
lines.ja: 私は黒実のために断龍の歯止めを訳し、限られた不死の指揮権を永続する支配へと変えた。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Cold, amused disdain.
lines.en: Testimony as self-harm. You have found a vice duller than blood.
lines.ja: 自傷としての証言か。血よりも退屈な悪癖を見つけたものだな。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Steady, unsentimental defense of Mateus's utility without granting absolution.
lines.en: His testimony is not a weapon against you or payment to us. It tells us which node carries the false command.
lines.ja: 彼の証言は貴様への武器でも、俺たちへの償いでもない。どの節に偽の命令が宿るかを教えるものだ。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Measured tactical declaration; revised oath put into action.
lines.en: My revised guard can protect a named ally across the gap. It does not target Kurozane's lineage or blood.
lines.ja: 書き換えた俺の守りは、隙間を越えて名指した仲間を庇える。黒実の血筋も血統も標的にはせん。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Silk-smooth condescension.
lines.en: You brought a footnote to a coronation.
lines.ja: 戴冠式に脚注を持ち込んだか。

lines.speaker: nikola
lines.direction: Quiet, sharp riposte; lands cleanly.
lines.en: A limit is most useful when power calls it small.
lines.ja: 権力がそれを小さいと笑うときほど、歯止めは役に立つ。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Cold imperial maxim; unhurried conviction.
lines.en: A country is quiet when every fear has a ledger.
lines.ja: あらゆる恐れに帳面が与えられたとき、国は静かになる。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Biting irony as the Whispering Archive speaks.
lines.en: Look how eagerly names become orders when they flatter your cause.
lines.ja: 己の大義に都合よいとなれば、名前がどれほど軽々しく命令へ変わるか見るがいい。

lines.speaker: kurozane
lines.direction: Sovereign crescendo before the Bell clash; echoing authority.
lines.en: Arrange yourselves around your paper heart. I have made nations kneel with less than its first beat.
lines.ja: 紙の心臓を囲んで陣を敷くがいい。その最初の鼓動にも満たぬ音で、余は国々を跪かせてきたのだ。
